title: Structured, flexible, and robust: benchmarking and improving large language models towards more human-like behavior in out-of-distribution reasoning tasks
reasoning: The paper focuses on cognitive reasoning tasks such as planning and causal explanation for everyday physical events (e.g., 'Clean the dirty dishes', 'If plants are not watered, then they die'). It does not evaluate or benchmark any aspects of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
